results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed the naturalsize function in src/humanize/filesize.py by setting the base to 1000 for decimal mode (when binary=False and gnu=False) and keeping base=1024 for binary and gnu modes. This ensures that decimal calculations use powers of 1000, making naturalsize(3000000) return '3.0 MB' as expected

results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Fixed the swapped implementation of ends_with and starts_with functions in jmespath/functions.py. The _func_ends_with was using str.startswith and _func_starts_with was using str.endswith, which was incorrect. Swapped the method calls so that ends_with uses str.endswith and starts_with uses str.star
